prompt: Writes get increasing sequence numbers: seq 1 `put x=1`, then a snapshot is taken (at seq 1), seq 2 `put x=2`, seq 3 `delete x`.

trace.label: Reading x through the old snapshot gives
Reading x on the live store gives
A new snapshot taken now reads x as

explain: A snapshot only sees versions with a sequence number at or below its own, so later writes and the delete are invisible to it. The live store and any new snapshot see the delete.
